scope: Corollary 6.3 (Specialization of all rational Hodge classes) of the manuscript “Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties” (preprints/Milnes-rationality-conjecture-for-abelian-varieties-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 001 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 640701a0ea8d8026), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every abelian variety A/Q of dimension d with good reduction A0/F at w, every 0 ≤ r ≤ d, and every rational Hodge class γ ∈ H2r (A(C), Q(r)), there is a unique class ργ ∈ Rr(A0) such that (ργ)ℓ = γ0,ℓ (ℓ ̸= p), (ργ)p ⊗ 1 = γ0,p. The prime-to-p equalities are in H2r ét (A0, Qℓ(r)); the crystalline equality is in H2r cris(A0/W(F))[1/p](r) ⊗K0 Cw. The specialization components are those of Theorem 1.1. The assertion holds for every prime p, including p = 2, with the prime, place, and theory fixed before A and γ vary.
